definitions: The place where an incident in real life or fiction occurs or occurred.
A division of an act in a play during which the action is continuous and in one place.
A display of strong feeling, especially in public.
A sphere of activity or interest.
examples: The police arrived at the scene of the crime.
The second scene of Act I is very dramatic.
The scene from the mountaintop was breathtaking.
Don't make a scene in front of everyone.
He's been involved in the music scene for years.
